The one factual conflict was the Nov 13 close: 162.85 in all three dossiers vs ~159.2 in the question background. It does not matter because Nov 16 is the anchor. I kept the shared random-walk anchor, set the median a touch above spot, and used a width consistent with the dispersion computation. I added a ~1% escape below $100 for a further leadership, regulatory or scandal shock. I did no retrieval on this run.
